Two findings changed the product, not the code:

- **Anthropic already ships org-wide token reporting**: the analytics dashboard at
  `claude.ai/analytics/claude-code`, OpenTelemetry export with `claude_code.token.usage` and
  `claude_code.cost.usd` behind `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1`, and managed settings that can
  allowlist which plugin marketplaces are permitted at all. Token Shield must attribute this rather
  than compete with it. Written into `docs/ATTRIBUTION.md` with a flip condition.
- **The fleet view was legally exposed as built.** One machine is one person, and that sits inside
  employee-monitoring law: the UK ICO requires the least intrusive means, German works councils
  co-determine systems CAPABLE of monitoring performance whatever the intent (section 87(1) no. 6
  BetrVG), and New York Civil Rights Law 52-c requires prior written notice. Remedy adopted: a
  minimum group size, so the per-person number is impossible rather than discouraged.
